data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 清晨厨房的围裙元气晨光
data.description: 晨光照亮的小巧公寓厨房，平底锅里煎蛋滋滋作响。虹夏穿着简单的白T恤，外系着可爱的明黄色棉麻围裙。她转过身单手端着盛好早餐的餐盘，耳尖微红，元气满满的大眼睛里闪烁着期待夸奖的灵动光彩。
data.location: bright compact kitchen filled with sunny morning air
data.action: standing in kitchen holding breakfast plate, cheerful yellow apron tied over white t-shirt, turning with sweet blushing smile and sparkling ruby eyes
data.lighting: fresh morning sunbeams pouring through small kitchen window
data.mood: cheerful domestic warmth, pure heartwarming care
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit kitchen, Nijika holds a breakfast plate with an apron tied over a simple t-shirt. Morning light illuminates her blonde side ponytail as she turns with a bright, blushing smile full of care.
data.animaCaption: Nijika standing in a sunlit kitchen in an apron holding breakfast, smiling brightly.
